interventions.description: Add a strip of vegetation, planters, or street furniture between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or tables to physically slow traffic to residential speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Patch the missing section of the sidewalk to ensure a level and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Install additional street trees or planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Planters
interventions.description: Install planters or curb extensions to provide a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes are high, a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage would improve connectivity.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Level or replace uneven sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface for all users.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Buffers
interventions.description: Install additional planters, bollards, or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed tables to manage vehicle speeds on this straight urban corridor.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Use high-visibility pavement markings or a continuous sidewalk material across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb-side Buffer
interventions.description: Install planters or bollards along the curb to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Maintain Pedestrian Clear Zone
interventions.description: Relocate temporary structures like portable toilets and large planters to the furniture zone or a designated on-street flex zone to maintain a continuous, unobstructed pedestrian clear path.

interventions.title: Dedicated bike lane markings
interventions.description: Clearly mark the side lanes for cycling or parking to better organize traffic and narrow the perceived travel lane for motor vehicles.
